name: Islander Food Shack
description: Welcome to the Islander Food Shack, a casual dining restaurant that opened in June 2016. Our menu features a variety of delicious options including fried pickles, famous Jamaican meat pies, gumbo, plus all the regulars like seafood and chicken. Our owner, Ed Caldwell, takes pride in providing a unique dining experience for all of our guests. Come visit us and enjoy a great meal with friends and family! Looking for a place to enjoy a refreshing frozen margarita or a unique Bushwacker? Look no further than our establishment! With both indoor and outdoor seating options, you can enjoy your drink of choice in any setting.
